name: Season of Hell's Legacy
endsNote: Blizzard has not announced an end date (as of Nov 12, 2026); community estimates are Dec 1 or Dec 8, 2026. Season 16 (patch 3.3.0) was on the PTR Oct 27 – Nov 3.

expansion.name: Lord of Hatred
expansion.note: Released Apr 28, 2026 (Season 13); added the Paladin and Warlock, level cap 70, Torment I–XII, War Plans, Horadric Cube and Talismans.

paragon.note: Season Rank adds up to 42 Paragon points.

dataNotes: Skill trees, upgrades, paragon boards, glyphs, items and aspects come from Maxroll's public Diablo IV game data (v3.2.1.73552). Builds come from Maxroll build-guide planners; tiers from the Mobalytics and Maxroll tier lists (dates on each build). Leveling spend orders follow each guide's own steps; endgame builds show the guide's final allocation with a derived point order. Paragon paths are the guide's allocated nodes (shown in a connected order). In Lord of Hatred the skill tree has no passives or key passives — each skill has 15 ranks and rows of upgrades.

mechanics.primeEvilNote: You carry one Splinter of Evil at a time; swap by claiming another in the largest Waking Nightmares. Build guides do not prescribe one — pick by the activity you farm.

activities.name: Waking Nightmares
activities.desc: Seasonal dungeons rebuilt from Diablo I, Hellfire, II, III and Immortal in three sizes; the largest recreate the Prime Evil fights and appear as top Capstone dungeons from Torment 10.

activities.name: War Plans
activities.desc: Lord of Hatred endgame plans across Whispers, Nightmare Dungeons, Helltide, Undercity, Lair Bosses, Infernal Hordes and the Pit. From Season 15 reputation is shared between matching characters, and 24 nodes have seasonal bonuses.

activities.name: Horadric Post & Cube
activities.desc: The Horadric Post is a one-way mailbox for rewards. The Horadric Cube fuses Soul Splinters, builds runewords and can upgrade a Unique to its Mythic version with affixes kept.

activities.name: Talisman (Seals & Charms)
activities.desc: A Seal holds Charms with set bonuses. Season 15 adds Mythic-quality Unique Charms, Legacy Unique charms, the Hellfire Torch and the Annihilus seal.

activities.name: Legacy Uniques & Runewords
activities.desc: Nine permanent Legacy Uniques (e.g. Stone of Jordan, Leoric's Crown), twelve D2 runes (Amn–Tir) and 19 runewords such as Enigma, Infinity and Grief.

tierList.supportNote: Mobalytics lists zDPS Support Paladin and zDPS Support Barbarian in a separate Support tier for group play.
tierList.note: Endgame and Pushing tiers: Mobalytics (Oct 13 / Oct 1). Leveling: Mobalytics (Sep 15), or Maxroll where Mobalytics does not list the build. Each build card shows the other site's rating too.

mechanic.name: Arsenal & Weapon Techniques
mechanic.desc: Carry four weapons (two-handed bludgeoning, two-handed slashing, dual wield) and assign each skill a weapon for its Weapon Expertise bonus. The Level 15 quest "Masters of Battle" (Forgemaster Kerdi, Ked Bardu) unlocks the Technique slot, which applies one weapon type's bonus to every attack.

builds.playstyle: Main skill: Call of the Ancients with the Empowered upgrade — Your Ancients are empowered: Korlic creates an Earthquake that deals X Physical damage over X seconds when he leaps. Talic leaves behind Dust Devils that deal X damage while he whirlwinds. Madawc ignites the earth, Burning enemies for an additional X damage over 4 seconds when he upheaves the…
rotation: Mighty Throw with the Mightiest variant is used with Aspect of Apogeic Furor to reset your other Ancient-summoning cooldowns. This skill should be assigned to your Two-Handed Mace. The Overpower upgrade lets you reliably activate Banished Lord's Talisman.

Call of the Ancients uses the same concept, except it also resets Mighty Throw. Alternating between these skills creates a loop that constantly resets the other. This allows you to use the Empowered variant freely (which normally has a fairly long cooldown) when combined with the Marshal Glyph.
Rallying Cry provides you with Fortify and Movement Speed, while also summoning Madawc to fight for you. Ideally, you want to spam this as often as possible.
War Cry gives you a multiplicative damage boost and is your main source of applying Vulnerable. Use it to summon Korlic to assist you with his Leap. Use this whenever it's off cooldown.

Challenging Shout provides you with a pretty decent damage reduction buff, while also Weakening enemies and increasing the damage they take. It also summons Talic for a bit of extra damage. Use this whenever it's off cooldown.
Iron Skin grants you a Barrier and the Unstoppable effect while it's active.

builds.playstyle: Main skill: Charge with the Battering Ram upgrade — Charge now deals Fire damage. Instead of swinging your weapon, colliding with enemies deals X Fire damage and Stuns them for X seconds. Additionally, you leave a burning trail that inflicts X Burning damage over 3 seconds.
rotation: Charge is your main skill and should be assigned to your Two-Handed Slashing weapon set. The Battering Ram upgrade removes the delayed swing that usually occurs when you cast it, while also leaving a Burning trail in your wake. This trail is where almost all of your damage comes from, rather than your direct hit.
Iron Skin with the Retaliation variant increases your Maximum Life and inflicts Weaken on enemies that hit you. Cast it whenever it's off cooldown.
Rallying Cry is used for its potent Movement Speed and Resource Generation buffs. Cast it every 4 seconds to zoom and make all your Fury costs negligible.
War Cry is used purely for its damage-boosting capability. Use it whenever it's off cooldown for a large damage multiplier.
Challenging Shout bolsters your defensives while active, providing a ton of damage reduction. Use it off cooldown or save it for any instance where there is a lot of incoming damage.

Wrath of the Berserker gives you a massive amount of extra damage while it's active, with the downside being its extremely long cooldown duration. Combat this by getting Cooldown Reduction on gear and utilizing Rage of Harrogath.

builds.playstyle: Main skill: Dread Claws.
rotation: Spam Dread Claws to deal damage.

Activate Rampage - Abyssal Titan to have a secondary source of Dread Claws - Enveloping Terror. Either keep him close to you for double bursts or cast him into a pack at range to clear two spots at once.
Profane Sentinel applies Vulnerable and triggers Dominion. Make sure to summon one of these (or Abyssal Titan if it timed out) every 20sec for the Paragon node.
Command Laalish also applies Vulnerable, grants Shadowform and triggers the Chains of Horazon bonuses. Cast this every 20sec for the set buffs.

Nether Step pulls your summons to you and extends their durations with Shadow Recall, so you rarely have to recast them throughout a run. Use this skill frequently to keep them up and gain extra speed + damage reduction. In the endgame, you only use the Evade version of this granted by Footfalls of the Waning World, making room for Sigil of Summons on your skill bar.

Sigil of Summons is an alternative option to extend your summons, great for boss fights or other prolonged encounters. Instead of spamming Nether Step, you park your summons inside to make them last forever. Swap Nether Step to this skill once you acquired Footfalls of the Waning World with an Attacks Reduce Evade Cooldown affix.

builds.playstyle: Main skill: Blazing Scream.
rotation: Jump onto Command Abodian back and ride into battle. Use to this quickly break CC's and gain Unstoppable. Recast again to hop off early.

Rampage is your primary mobility option, when used with Anathema of the Primes in a speedfarming session. The skill points are left in the tree so you don't have to swap them out. Replace the Sigil skill, since you don't use Phoba of the Nameless set with the setup.
When using the 2 Set Charm setup you can swap Rampage to Nether Step.
Cast Metamorphosis and don't click this skill again. Recast this if the buff ever falls off.
Cast Dark Prison to increase your survivability. Killing enemies inside its area resets its cooldown so make sure to only use this when actively fighting so it doesn't fall off prematurely.
Cast Molten Bomb as needed for Resource generation. The added turrets left behind help to further automate this engine.

builds.playstyle: Main skill: Command Fallen with the Dominance upgrade — Every 15 times you hit enemies with Command Fallen you gain 1 Dominance.
rotation: Command Fallen is your main attack. The Mega Lunatic variant sends out a large lunatic that splits into three smaller lunatics. These scatter and help with AoE clear while providing tons of fuel for effects such as Dominance, Legion Shard and Sigil of Summons

Metamorphosis raises DPS through Damage Scaling and Dominance. IMPORTANT: Destruction Demon continuously burns yourself when casting skills. This is mostly negated by Sadistic Aspect but it may overwhelm you. Just swap out of the form and activate it again once the cooldown is up.
Command Ae'grom comes from your Soul Shard and summons a small army of meat shields that also grant various bonuses from your set and Soul Shard. Use it once every 20sec.
Rampage - Demonic Smash is your primary mobility tool. You regenerate Dominance quickly thanks to Dominance and the Chains of Horazon set to jump around often.

Tortured Wretch taunts enemies, generates Fortify and provides a life absorb, making you absurdly tanky. Additionally, it ramps up your damage through the Chains of Horazon 2-piece bonus. Use this on elites and bosses.

Sigil of Summons extends the duration of Tortured Wretch and improves all your output thanks to Damage. In addition, the Summon Hellwyrm variant allows you to double cast your Command Fallen, greatly helping with bosses and tanky elites.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.desc: Hemorrhage grants 1 stack of Overpower.

nodes.name: Weaken
nodes.desc: Hemorrhage Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Cast Speed
nodes.desc: Hemorrhage gains an additional 20%[+] Cast Speed.

nodes.name: Blood Orb
nodes.desc: Hemorrhage has an additional 30% chance to form a Blood Orb.

nodes.name: Blood Boil
nodes.desc: Hemorrhage also deals X damage to enemies around your target.

nodes.name: Blood Runs Cold
nodes.desc: Hemorrhage deals X Cold damage and Freezes enemies for X seconds. An enemy can be Frozen this way once every 6 seconds. If Hemorrhage hits an enemy already Frozen, it has an additional 50% chance to form a Blood Orb.

nodes.name: Soul Rip
nodes.desc: Hemorrhage becomes a Darkness Skill that deals X Shadow damage. Instead of forming a Blood Orb, Hemorrhage Summons a Volatile Skeleton that deals X damage.

nodes.name: Ferocity
nodes.desc: Reap grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

nodes.name: Corpse Generation
nodes.desc: Reap forms a Corpse under the first enemy hit.

nodes.name: Essence Generation
nodes.desc: Reap generates 2 additional Essence per enemy hit.

nodes.name: Critical Strike Chance
nodes.desc: Reap gains an additional 10%[+] Critical Strike Chance.

nodes.name: Chilled To The Bone
nodes.desc: Reap deals X Cold damage and Chills for X. Reap gains an additional 30%[+] Cast Speed.

nodes.name: Cull The Weak
nodes.desc: Reap becomes a Blood Skill that deals X Physical damage. Reap will Execute enemies and has a 50% chance to form a Blood Orb if they are killed by it.

nodes.name: Harvest
nodes.desc: Reap sweeps a second time, dealing X damage and generating 7.5 Essence.

nodes.name: Maximum Essence
nodes.desc: Each enemy hit by Bone Spirit increases your Maximum Essence by 2 for 15 seconds, up to 20 Essence.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Every second, your next Bone Spirit deals 10%[x] increased damage, up to 30%[x].

nodes.name: Charges
nodes.desc: Bone Spirit gains 1 additional Charge and its Charge Cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Core Skill
nodes.desc: Bone Spirit becomes a Core Skill, costs 30 Essence, and no longer has a Cooldown. Bone Spirit will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast, dealing 3%[x] increased damage for each point of Essence consumed.

nodes.name: Astral Projection
nodes.desc: Bone Spirit no longer seeks enemies and instead spirals around you, piercing through enemies and exploding for X damage when it hits them.

nodes.name: Unfinished Business
nodes.desc: Bone Spirit becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage. Bone Spirit leaves behind a pool of Desecrated Ground when it explodes, dealing X Corrupting damage.

nodes.name: Poltergeists
nodes.desc: When Bone Spirit explodes, it spawns 3 smaller spirits that seek enemies and explode for X damage each.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Decompose deals 50%[x] increased damage

nodes.name: Barrier
nodes.desc: Decompose grants a Barrier every second for 10% of your Maximum Life (#) that lasts X seconds.

nodes.name: Crowd Control
nodes.desc: Decompose Slows enemies by 50%.

nodes.name: Lucky Hit Chance
nodes.desc: Decompose has an additional 30%[+] Lucky Hit Chance.

nodes.name: Rip and Tear
nodes.desc: Decompose becomes a Bone Skill that deals Physical damage. Decompose now hits all other enemies in between you and the primary target.

nodes.name: Putrid Burst
nodes.desc: Decompose causes a burst around the target every second, dealing an additional X damage to them and nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Dry Rot
nodes.desc: Decompose chains to 3 additional enemies.

nodes.name: Blood Orb
nodes.desc: Corpse Explosion has a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.

nodes.name: Corpse Efficiency
nodes.desc: Corpses consumed by Corpse Explosion can be consumed 1 additional time.

nodes.name: Bloody Mess
nodes.desc: Corpse Explosion's Size is increased by 50% and damage is increased by 75%[x].

nodes.name: Miasma
nodes.desc: Corpse Explosion is also a Darkness Skill and, instead of exploding, releases a vile miasma dealing X Corrupting damage over 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Shrapnel
nodes.desc: Corpse Explosion is also a Bone Skill and, instead of exploding, fires 8 piercing bone shards dealing X damage each.

nodes.name: Multiple Corpses
nodes.desc: Corpse Explosion detonates up to 2 additional corpses.

nodes.name: Essence Generation
nodes.desc: Casting Corpse Explosion generates 15 Essence.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.desc: Blood Lance consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to throw an additional lance, dealing 50% of normal damage.

nodes.name: Cost Reduction
nodes.desc: Blood Lance's Essence cost is reduced by 3.

nodes.name: Fortify
nodes.desc: Blood Lance Fortifies you for 4% of your Maximum Life (#) if it hits an enemy already lanced.

nodes.name: Ricochet
nodes.desc: Blood Lance ricochets to 1 additional enemy.

nodes.name: Festering Wound
nodes.desc: Blood Lance becomes a Darkness Skill and deals Shadow damage. Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals X Corrupting damage per second to them.

nodes.name: Gore Quills
nodes.desc: Every 3rd cast of Blood Lance forms a Blood Orb under the first enemy hit. Casting Blood Lance will pick up a Blood Orb around you and conjure an additional lance from it, dealing 125% of normal damage.

nodes.name: Blood Seeker
nodes.desc: Blood Lance deals 50%[x] increased damage per lanced enemy, and an additional 50%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.desc: Blood Surge consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to gain 25% and 50%[x] increased damage.

nodes.name: Weaken
nodes.desc: Blood Surge Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Pins and Needles
nodes.desc: Blood Surge becomes a Bone Skill and, instead of expelling a blood nova, expels 10 piercing bone shards dealing X damage each. Instead of dealing increased damage, Blood Surge expels 1 additional shard for each enemy drawn from, up to 5 additional shards.

nodes.name: You And What Army?
nodes.desc: Blood Surge expels smaller blood novas on your Minions, dealing X damage. Blood Surge's minion nova damage is increased by 5%[x] for each enemy drawn from, up to 50%[x].

nodes.name: Bloodbath
nodes.desc: Blood Surge's nova echoes again after a short delay, dealing X damage.

nodes.name: Fortify
nodes.desc: Blood Surge Fortifies you for 2% of your Maximum Life (#) for each enemy drawn from, up to 10%.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Blood Surge deals 25%[x] increased damage while you are Healthy.

nodes.name: Pierce Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Bone Spear deals 10%[x] increased damage per enemy pierced, up to 50%[x].

nodes.name: Resolve
nodes.desc: Bone Spear deals 5%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage per stack of Resolve, up to 40%[x].

nodes.name: Shadow Splitter
nodes.desc: Bone Spear becomes a Darkness Skill that deals X Shadow damage. Instead of piercing through, Bone Spear forks into 2 piercing spears each time it hits an enemy or wall, up to 2 times.

nodes.name: Blood Spear
nodes.desc: Bone Spear becomes a Blood Skill that deals X damage. Casting Bone Spear consumes a nearby Corpse and conjures a second Bone Spear from it, dealing 100% of normal damage.

nodes.name: Bone Spikes
nodes.desc: Bone Spear breaks into 3 piercing bone shards when it is destroyed, dealing X damage each.

nodes.name: First Hit Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Bone Spear deals 40%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit.

nodes.name: Cost Reduction
nodes.desc: Bone Spear's Essence cost is reduced by 5.

nodes.name: Crowd Control Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Blight deals 30%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

nodes.name: Lucky Hit Chance
nodes.desc: Blight has an additional 20%[+] Lucky Hit Chance.

nodes.name: Volatile Blood
nodes.desc: Blight becomes a Blood skill that deals Physical damage. Blight's defiled area instantly bursts, dealing X damage.

nodes.name: Whirlpool
nodes.desc: Blight deals Cold and Frostbite damage and its Essence Cost is reduced by 10. Its defiled area Pulls in enemies and Chills for X every second.

nodes.name: Piercing Darkness
nodes.desc: Blight pierces 1 time and can spawn an additional defiled area. Blight deals 75%[x] increased damage to Bosses.

nodes.name: Size Bonus
nodes.desc: Blight's Size is increased by 35%.

nodes.name: Area Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Blight's defiled area deals 40%[x] increased damage.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Sever deals 10%[x] increased damage, and an additional 1%[x] increased damage for each Minion you have.

nodes.name: Cost Reduction
nodes.desc: Sever's Essence cost is reduced by 4.

nodes.name: Reaping Lotus
nodes.desc: Sever sends out 3 additional specters at its apex that expand out, dealing X damage each.

nodes.name: Inexorable Reaper
nodes.desc: Sever is also a Mobility Skill that dashes you forward to attack instead.

nodes.name: Cold Pursuit
nodes.desc: Sever deals Cold damage, Chills for 15%, and seeks another enemy to attack again.

nodes.name: Crowd Control and Corpse Generation
nodes.desc: Sever Slows enemies by 40% for 3 seconds and forms a Corpse.

nodes.name: Ferocity
nodes.desc: Sever deals 7%[x] increased damage per stack of Ferocity.

nodes.name: Critical Strike
nodes.desc: Blood Mist grants 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance for 5 seconds after it ends.

nodes.name: Movement Speed
nodes.desc: Blood Mist increases your Movement Speed by 30%[x] for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Blood Transfusion
nodes.desc: Blood Mist Fortifies you for 30% of your Maximum Life (#) over its duration and forms a Blood Orb every second.

nodes.name: Blood Rush
nodes.desc: Blood Mist is now also a Mobility Skill and its Cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds. Instead of dispersing you into a bloody mist, Blood Mist consumes a nearby corpse to teleport you to the target location and grants Unstoppable for X seconds.

nodes.name: Devouring Mist
nodes.desc: Blood Mist becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage. Blood Mist now deals X Shadow damage over its duration and applies Vampiric Curse to enemies.

nodes.name: Vulnerable and Slow
nodes.desc: Blood Mist makes enemies Vulnerable and Slows them by 70% for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.desc: Bone Prison reduces your active Cooldowns by 0.5 seconds for each enemy trapped, up to 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Essence Generation
nodes.desc: Casting Bone Prison generates 50 Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional 25 Essence.

nodes.name: Bramble
nodes.desc: You gain X Thorns for each enemy trapped by Bone Prison. When a segment of Bone Prison is destroyed or expires, it deals 100% of your Thorns around itself.

nodes.name: Plunging Darkness
nodes.desc: Bone Prison becomes a Darkness Skill. Bone Prison forms a Corpse every second and spawns a pool of Desecrated Ground, dealing X Corrupting damage.

nodes.name: Life Imprisonment
nodes.desc: Bone Prison becomes a Blood Skill, casting the prison around you. While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by X, but it drains 5% of your Maximum Life every second.

nodes.name: Vulnerable
nodes.desc: Bone Prison makes enemies Vulnerable for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Resolve
nodes.desc: Bone Prison grants 1 stack of Resolve for each enemy trapped.

nodes.name: Ferocity and Overpower
nodes.desc: Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Iron Maiden have up to a 15% chance to randomly grant 1 stack of Ferocity or Overpower.

nodes.name: Vulnerable
nodes.desc: Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden are Vulnerable.

nodes.name: Blood Maiden
nodes.desc: Iron Maiden is also a Blood Skill, causing enemies damaged by it to have a 5% chance to form a Blood Orb. Casting Iron Maiden picks up 4 Blood Orbs in the target area and causes them to burst for X damage.

nodes.name: Torture Artist
nodes.desc: Iron Maiden is also a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage. Enemies have 30% chance to be stunned for 2 seconds when they take damage from Iron Maiden.

nodes.name: Schadenfreude
nodes.desc: While at least 1 enemy is afflicted with Iron Maiden, you gain X Thorns. Iron Maiden's damage is increased by 100% of your Thorns.

nodes.name: Execute and Fortify
nodes.desc: Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden will be Executed. You are Fortified for 5% of your Maximum Life (#) when an enemy dies while afflicted with Iron Maiden.

nodes.name: Essence Generation
nodes.desc: Iron Maiden no longer has an Essence cost and instead generates 5 Essence for each enemy you curse that was not already afflicted with Iron Maiden.

nodes.name: Resolve
nodes.desc: Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 25% chance to grant 1 stack of Resolve.

nodes.name: Movement Speed
nodes.desc: Each enemy afflicted with Decrepify increases your Movement Speed by 2%[x].

nodes.name: Unholy Frenzy
nodes.desc: Instead of afflicting enemies Decrepify is now applied to your Minions, granting them X increased Cast Speed and Movement Speed.

nodes.name: Life Tap
nodes.desc: Decrepify is also a Blood Skill, healing for X of your Maximum Life (#) whenever you hit an enemy afflicted with it, up to once a second. Enemies that die while afflicted with Decrepify have a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.

nodes.name: Dizzying Curse
nodes.desc: The first time an enemy is afflicted with Decrepify they are Dazed for X seconds.

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.desc: Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 15% chance to reduce a random active Cooldown by 1 second.

nodes.name: Critical Strike Chance
nodes.desc: You have an additional 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance against enemies afflicted with Decrepify.

nodes.name: Critical Strike Chance
nodes.desc: You gain an additional 5%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance for 6 seconds against enemies damaged by Corpse Tendrils.

nodes.name: Essence Generation
nodes.desc: Casting Corpse Tendrils generates 35 Essence.

nodes.name: Bitter Harvest
nodes.desc: Corpse Tendrils no longer consumes the Corpse. Enemies are Immobilized for 3 seconds after being Pulled in.

nodes.name: Get Over Here!
nodes.desc: Corpse Tendrils is no longer cast on a Corpse and is cast on you instead. Corpse Tendrils Fortifies you for 5% of your Maximum Life (#) for each enemy it damages.

nodes.name: Jaws Of Death
nodes.desc: Corpse Tendrils now deals X damage and no longer has a delay before Pulling in enemies.

nodes.name: Vulnerable
nodes.desc: Corpse Tendrils makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Lucky Hit Chance
nodes.desc: Corpse Tendrils gains an additional 40%[+] Lucky Hit Chance.

nodes.name: Blood Orb
nodes.desc: Blood Wave forms up to 2 Blood Orbs as it travels.

nodes.name: Hematolagnia
nodes.desc: Blood Wave becomes a Core Skill, has no Cooldown, but costs 70 Essence. Blood Wave conjures a shorter wave that deals X damage and no longer Knocks Back enemies.

nodes.name: Path of Darkness
nodes.desc: Blood Wave becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage. Blood Wave leaves behind a trail of Desecrated Ground as it travels that deals X Corrupting damage.

nodes.name: Tides of Blood
nodes.desc: Blood Wave launches 1 additional wave, dealing X damage.

nodes.name: Damage Reduction
nodes.desc: Casting Blood Wave grants 10% Damage Reduction for X seconds.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Blood Wave deals 30%[x] increased damage while you are Fortified.

nodes.name: Movement Speed
nodes.desc: While Soulrift is active you are Unhindered and gain 1%[+] increased Movement Speed for every soul absorbed, up to 40%[+]. This bonus persists for 5 seconds after Soulrift ends.

nodes.name: Barrier
nodes.desc: Every soul absorbed by Soulrift grants a Barrier for 0.5% of your Maximum Life (#). This Barrier persists for 5 seconds after Soulrift ends.

nodes.name: Distilled Anima
nodes.desc: While Soulrift is active, your Darkness damage is increased by X.

nodes.name: Soul Vortex
nodes.desc: Soulrift is cast at the target location and its Cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds. Absorbing an enemy's soul deals X damage and Pulls them in.

nodes.name: Frozen Wasteland
nodes.desc: Soulrift deals Frostbite damage and Chills for 30% every second. If Soulrift absorbs the soul of a Frozen enemy, they shatter and explode for X damage.

nodes.name: Vulnerable and Crowd Control
nodes.desc: When Soulrift absorbs an enemy's soul it makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds. After Soulrift ends, all surrounding enemies are Feared and Slowed by 85% for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Ferocity
nodes.desc: Every 30 souls absorbed by Soulrift grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

nodes.name: Damage Reduction
nodes.desc: Bone Storm increases your Damage Reduction by X.

nodes.name: Duration Increase
nodes.desc: Bone Storm consumes up to 4 corpses to increase its duration by 2 seconds per corpse.

nodes.name: Roll The Bones
nodes.desc: Bone Storm increases your Critical Strike Chance and Cast Speed by X.

nodes.name: Shadow And Bone
nodes.desc: Bone Storm becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage. Enemies damaged by it suffer an additional X Corrupting damage over 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Hungry Cyclone
nodes.desc: Bone Storm is cast at the target location and seeks enemies. Its Cooldown is reduced by X seconds.

nodes.name: Vulnerable
nodes.desc: Bone Storm makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Barrier
nodes.desc: Casting Bone Storm grants a Barrier for 50% of your Maximum Life (#) for X seconds.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Army of the Dead deals 2%[x] increased damage for each Minion you have.

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.desc: Army of the Dead's Cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.

nodes.name: Dead Cold
nodes.desc: Army of the Dead now deals X Cold damage and Freezes enemies instead of Stunning them.

nodes.name: Pile the Bodies
nodes.desc: Army of the Dead will converge on your target. Each time a Volatile Skeleton explodes on an enemy, they take 10%[x] increased damage from your Army of the Dead, up to 300%[x].

nodes.name: Unyielding Commander
nodes.desc: While Army of the Dead is active, your Minions take 90% reduced damage and deal X increased damage.

nodes.name: Passive Bonus
nodes.desc: Army of the Dead passively summons a Volatile Skeleton every 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Corpse Generation
nodes.desc: Army of the Dead has a 50% chance to form a Corpse.

nodes.name: Duration Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Skeleton Mages deal 15%[x] increased damage. This bonus increases by 1% every second that the skeletal mage is alive, up to 25%[x].

nodes.name: Critical Strike Chance
nodes.desc: You gain an additional 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance against enemies damaged by Skeleton Mages.

nodes.name: Coven
nodes.desc: Skeleton Mage's maximum number of mages is increased by 2.

nodes.name: Gift of Death
nodes.desc: Skeleton Mage is also a Corpse Skill and requires a Corpse to be raised. Each active skeletal mage increases your Essence Regeneration by X.

nodes.name: Singularity
nodes.desc: Skeleton Mage will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast to raise a more powerful but temporary mage. The skeletal mage deals 3%[x] increased damage and lasts for 0.1 seconds for each point of Essence consumed.

nodes.name: Crowd Control Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Skeleton Mages deal 30%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

nodes.name: Ferocity, Resolve, or Overpower
nodes.desc: Skeleton Mages have a 5% chance to grant 1 stack of Ferocity, Resolve, or Overpower whenever they attack based on whether your Skeleton Mage type is Shadow, Cold, or Bone respectively.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Commanding your Skeleton Warriors causes them to deal 25%[x] increased damage for 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Healing
nodes.desc: Skeleton Warriors heal you for 2% of your Maximum Life (#) whenever they attack.

nodes.name: Master of Puppets
nodes.desc: Skeleton Warrior's maximum number of warriors is increased by 3.

nodes.name: Service and Sacrifice
nodes.desc: Skeleton Warriors lose 25% of their Maximum Life per second while in combat and explode on death, dealing X damage. Skeleton Warriors are now raised from a nearby Corpse every 0.5 seconds.

nodes.name: Litany of Death
nodes.desc: If all of your skeletal warriors have been Summoned, Skeleton Warrior briefly Summons a Skeleton Priest instead. Skeleton Priest empowers your Minions for 8 seconds, increasing their Critical Strike Chance by X and healing them for 100% of their Maximum Life over the duration.

nodes.name: Vulnerable
nodes.desc: Skeleton Warriors have a 30% chance to make enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Resolve
nodes.desc: Commanding your Skeleton Warriors grants 3 stacks of Resolve.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Golem deals 30%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

nodes.name: Unstoppable
nodes.desc: Commanding your Golem also grants you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Gargantua
nodes.desc: Golem now raises a larger Golem that gains an aura of command, increasing the Cast Speed and Movement Speed of your other Minions by X.

nodes.name: Fel Gluttony
nodes.desc: Commanding your Golem causes it to erupt, dealing X damage to surrounding enemies. Your Golem passively consumes nearby Corpses every second to reduce its Cooldown by 2 seconds per Corpse consumed.

nodes.name: Gravebloom
nodes.desc: Golem now raises 3 smaller Golems that deal 60% of normal damage and gain 30%[+] Attack Speed.

nodes.name: Weaken
nodes.desc: Golem Weakens enemies for 4 seconds whenever it attacks.

nodes.name: Resolve, Overpower, or Ferocity
nodes.desc: Commanding your Golem grants 3 stacks of Resolve, Overpower, or Ferocity based on whether your Golem type is Bone, Blood, or Iron respectively.

builds.playstyle: Main skill: Blood Wave with the Damage Bonus upgrade — Blood Wave deals 30%[x] increased damage while you are Fortified.
rotation: You can literally play this build just pressing Blood Wave and nothing else. But there are few key things you can do to improve your rotation especially for teleporting and speed.
Use dash via Enigma to teleport near monsters. When there is a corpse, you use Blood Mist to activate continue teleporting via Blood Rush and also gain unstoppable.

When close to monsters, cast Blood Wave. (Any blood skill casts spend an overpower from Red Blessing. Blood Orb from Blood Wave generates a lot of orbs and these are auto picked up by Iron Maiden and generates OP stacks back. You don't even have to manually cast Iron Maiden as this is automated by Teb rune. This engine works beautifully together to spend and gain OP stacks naturally and also activates multipliers from Bloodbath Legendary node. )
Iron Maiden also applies vulnerable.
Main rotation is just teleport teleport! And spam Blood Wave.

Cast Bone Prison to gain extra attack speed. You may not even need to since Blood Wave when fully locked in one shots most t12 stuff but if you are fighting tankier targets and they are able to survive your multiple hits, Bone Prison increases your DPS significantly.

builds.playstyle: Main skill: Blessed Shield.
rotation: Use Clash to activate Punishment. Use this to help generate Resolve, and also to activate Ward of the White Dove's unique affix.
Cast Holy Light Aura to apply Judgement and activate your Phoba of Radiant Fire set bonus. Press this off cooldown to insure you maintain the buff. Holy Light Aura also grants you Fortify and heals.
Cast Blessed Shield 3 times, remember to stay close to your target for maximum damage. After this, cast any other ability to maintain the buff from Ward of the White Dove.
Cast Fanaticism Aura to apply Weaken to enemies.
Use Defiance Aura to activate Unstoppable when hit by a crowd control effect.

Fortress with Resolve Damage Bonus gives you a huge damage bonus thanks to your Maximum Resolve tempers and caps your Resolve almost instantly when standing within the zone. Enhance it with Free Cast to use your skills without spending resources.

builds.playstyle: Main skill: Shield Charge.
rotation: Shield Charge is your main source of damage with Retribution. Make sure you maximize the amount of enemies you hit with it by positioning accordingly to trigger Hit Count As Blocking as often as possible.
Clash gives you the Crusader's March buff, which provides Retribution chance, Thorns damage and Block Chance. Make sure you keep the buff up by using this ability at least once every 6 seconds.
Fortress makes you Immune for 3 seconds and also provides a huge damage boost from the Resolve Damage Bonus upgrade.
Condemn helps with gathering enemies and provides additional sources of Unhindered, Vulnerable and Weaken.

The left over Skill Points can be applied to any skill you want, this also allows you to use the full skill tree even if you haven't received all your skill points from the Season Journey. (The Devourer: Sky and Soil increases movement speed with +Ranks)

Ravager's variant Flurry of Claws provides Cool Down Effectiveness (CDE) in which the % amount listed, this value goes up in ranks. This CDE increases the time that each second actually "consumes" of remaining cooldown on your skills. So having 100% CDE means that every 1 second of time is 2 seconds of cooldown that is reduced on skills. This can be used in conjunction with Cool Down Reduction (CDR) and isn't capped.
Toxic Skin's variant Skuttle Bug provides additional +Armor% while active, this value also goes up with +Ranks. This value is combined with all other sources of +Armor% (Paragon, Resolve, etc)

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.desc: Incinerate gains a 20% chance to deal double damage while you have a stack of Overpower.

nodes.name: Focused Flame
nodes.desc: Incinerate maximum damage bonus while channeling is increased to 200%[x]. Incinerate's Size is increased by 200% when you reach the maximum damage bonus.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.desc: Incinerate Executes enemies.

nodes.name: Healing
nodes.desc: Incinerate heals you for 2% of your Maximum Life (#) per enemy hit.

nodes.name: Healthy Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Incinerate deals 25%[x] increased damage while you are Healthy.

nodes.name: Instantaneous Destruction
nodes.desc: Fireball travels 200% faster and deals 75%[x] increased damage.

nodes.name: Illumination
nodes.desc: Fireball now bounces as it travels and explodes each time it hits the ground, dealing 75% of normal damage.

nodes.name: Frostball
nodes.desc: Fireball becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage. When Fireball hits an enemy it creates 3 Ice Spikes around them, dealing X damage each.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Fireball deals 40%[x] increased damage, but its Mana cost is increased by 15.

nodes.name: Size Bonus
nodes.desc: Fireball's Size is increased by 50%[+].

nodes.name: Damage Over Time
nodes.desc: Fireball's direct damage deals an additional 30% damage over 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Critical Strike Damage
nodes.desc: Fireball deals 30%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage.

nodes.name: Explosion Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Frozen Orb deals 30%[x] increased explosion damage.

nodes.name: Duration Bonus
nodes.desc: Frozen Orb lasts 1 additional second before exploding.

nodes.name: Barrier
nodes.desc: Frozen Orb grants a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life (#) for X seconds for each enemy hit by its explosion, up to 50%.

nodes.name: Seeking Orb
nodes.desc: When Frozen Orb first explodes it remains stationary for 0.5 seconds then seeks another target to explode again, dealing X damage.

nodes.name: Shattered Path
nodes.desc: Ice Spikes spawn around Frozen Orb, dealing X damage. Frozen Orb makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Great Orbs of Fire
nodes.desc: Frozen Orb becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals X Burning damage over 2 seconds and explodes for X Fire damage Frozen Orb will consume 1 stack of Overpower to explode 3 times along its path.

nodes.name: Damage Over Time Bonus
nodes.desc: Frozen Orb deals 100%[x] increased damage.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Charged Bolts deals 15%[x] increased damage to Close enemies. Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

nodes.name: Weaken
nodes.desc: Charged Bolts Weakens enemies for 6 seconds. Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

nodes.name: Movement Speed
nodes.desc: Each time you cast Charged Bolts it gains 4%[x] bolt speed and you gain 4% Movement Speed for X seconds, up to 20%[x]. Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

nodes.name: Surging Charge
nodes.desc: Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt, plus 1 additional bolt per stack of Ferocity.

nodes.name: Cast Speed
nodes.desc: Each time you cast Charged Bolts it gains 5%[+] Cast Speed, up to 15%[+]. Moving removes this effect. Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

nodes.name: Burn Through
nodes.desc: Charged Bolts becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals Fire damage, and costs 30 Mana. Each bolt no longer pierces and instead releases 2 to 3 explosions on impact, dealing an additional X damage.

nodes.name: Overload
nodes.desc: Casting Charged Bolts now also discharges Crackling Energy in an electric wave, dealing its damage to all enemies caught in it. Crackling Energy will no longer automatically pulse its last 3 charges.

nodes.name: Chain of Cold
nodes.desc: Chain Lightning becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage. Chain Lightning Chills by 25% and deals up to 100%[x] increased damage based on how Chilled the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are Frozen.

nodes.name: Chain Whipping
nodes.desc: Chain Lightning gains 20%[+] Cast Speed and its number of chains is doubled.

nodes.name: Power Flux
nodes.desc: Chain Lightning alternates between chaining to an enemy and to you. When it chains to you, it gains 45%[x] increased damage, up to 180%[x], and does not use a chain.

nodes.name: Critical Strike Chance
nodes.desc: Chain Lightning forms a Crackling Energy whenever it Critically Strikes. Chain Lightning gains 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance.

nodes.name: Ramping Damage
nodes.desc: Every Second, Chain Lightning gains 5%[x] damage, up to 25%[x]. This bonus is reset when you damage an enemy with a Skill Cast other than Chain Lightning.

nodes.name: Additional Chains
nodes.desc: Chain Lightning gains 1 additional chains.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Chain Lightning deals 100%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit.

nodes.name: Thunderbolt
nodes.desc: Ice Shards becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage. Ice Shards launches a large thunderbolt that explodes on impact into 5 smaller seeking thunderbolt shards, dealing X damage each.

nodes.name: Glacial Spike
nodes.desc: Ice Shards combines all shards into a massive spike, dealing 10%[x] increased damage per shard. The spike explodes on impact and Chills for 50%.

nodes.name: Piercing Cold
nodes.desc: Ice Shards deals 50%[x] increased damage and will pierce 1 additional time. Ice Shards will additionally pierce up to 3 Vulnerable enemies.

nodes.name: Pierce Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Ice Shards deals 20%[x] increased damage after piercing once.

nodes.name: Hit Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Ice Shards deals 10%[x] increased damage to an enemy each time it hits them in the same cast.

nodes.name: Barrier
nodes.desc: Ice Shards launches 1 additional shard while you have a Barrier.

nodes.name: Cost Reduction
nodes.desc: Ice Shards' Mana cost is reduced by 3.

nodes.name: Duration Bonus
nodes.desc: Flame Shield's duration is increased to 1.5 seconds.

nodes.name: Scorch
nodes.desc: Flame Shield instantly scorches close enemies, dealing X damage and Immobilizing them for X seconds.

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.desc: Flame Shield's Cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Healing
nodes.desc: While Flame Shield is active, you heal for 12% of your Maximum Life (#) per second.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.desc: Flame Shield grants 1 stack of Overpower.

nodes.name: Flash
nodes.desc: Flame Shield becomes a Shock Skill, deals Sparking damage, and triggers its Cooldown on Cast. Instead of becoming Immune you embody lightning, generating X Crackling Energy per second and gaining X Movement Speed and X Dodge.

nodes.name: Firebird
nodes.desc: Flame Shield rains down X Meteorites per second that deal X damage.

nodes.name: Wormhole
nodes.desc: Teleport Stuns enemies hit for X seconds, and there is a 2 second window where you can cast Teleport again.

nodes.name: Blaze
nodes.desc: Teleport becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals X Fire damage. Teleport now only dashes you forward a short distance and will consume 1 stack of Overpower to refund its Cooldown.

nodes.name: Ferocity
nodes.desc: Teleport grants 2 stack of Ferocity if it hits an enemy.

nodes.name: Movement Speed
nodes.desc: Teleport increases your Movement Speed by 10%[+] for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Electrobolt
nodes.desc: Teleport pulls in all Close Crackling Energy and reduces the Cooldown of the next Teleport by X seconds per Crackling Energy gained this way.

nodes.name: Crackling Energy
nodes.desc: Teleport forms 2 Crackling Energy at the ending location.

nodes.name: Weaken
nodes.desc: Teleport Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Resource Regeneration
nodes.desc: Ice Armor grants X Mana Regeneration while active.

nodes.name: Blast Chill
nodes.desc: Ice Armor also applies to Nearby Allies and increases All Resistances by X.

nodes.name: Razor Ice
nodes.desc: Ice Armor forms X Ice Spikes per second under Close enemies that deal X damage.

nodes.name: Permafrost
nodes.desc: Ice Armor grants Unstoppable for 1 second and increases your Armor by X while active.

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.desc: Ice Armor's Cooldown is reduced to X seconds.

nodes.name: Frozen and Chill
nodes.desc: Close enemies that attack you while Ice Armor is active will be Frozen or Chilled for X.

nodes.name: Duration Bonus and Barrier
nodes.desc: Ice Armor's duration is increased to X seconds and its Barrier amount is increased by 20%[x].

nodes.name: Freezing Mist
nodes.desc: Instead of Freezing, Frost Nova forms an aura of frigid mist around you that deals X Frostbite damage over X seconds.

nodes.name: Vulnerable
nodes.desc: Frost Nova makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Size Bonus
nodes.desc: Frost Nova's Size is increased by 50%.

nodes.name: Cold Front
nodes.desc: Frost Nova is now cast at a target location, and each enemy Frozen by it reduces the cooldowns of your Frost Skills by 0.5 seconds.

nodes.name: Shatter
nodes.desc: Enemies that die while Frozen by Frost Nova have a 100% chance to unleash an additional Frost Nova.

nodes.name: Resource Generation
nodes.desc: Each enemy Frozen by Frost Nova generates 5 Mana.

nodes.name: Charge
nodes.desc: Frost Nova gains 1 additional Charge, but its Cooldown is increased by 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Charge
nodes.desc: Familiar gains 1 additional Charge.

nodes.name: Size Bonus
nodes.desc: Familiar's explosion radius is increased by 50%.

nodes.name: Duration Bonus
nodes.desc: Familiar's duration is increased by 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Healing Flames
nodes.desc: Casting Familiar grants 1 stack of Overpower and restores X of your Maximum Life (#) per second while active.

nodes.name: Bonus Effect
nodes.desc: Gain a bonus based on the Familiar type when the Familiar explodes: Fire Familiar Gain Healing Received for 5 seconds. Cold Familiar Gain a Barrier for X of your Maximum Life (#) for X seconds, up to X. Lightning Familiar Reduce a random active Cooldown by X |4second:seconds;.

nodes.name: Freezing Familiar
nodes.desc: Familiar becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage. Familiar Chills for X and Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Fast As Lightning
nodes.desc: Familiar becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage. Familiar increases your Minimum Ferocity by 1 and grants X Cooldown Reduction while active.

nodes.name: Prismatic Familiar
nodes.desc: Familiar becomes a Pyromancy, Shock, and Frost Skill that summons a stationary Prismatic Familiar. Casting Skills will cause Prismatic Familiar to apply X Frostbite, Sparking, or Burning damage over X seconds to surrounding enemies based on the Element Cast.

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.desc: Hydra reduces the Cooldown of a random Skill by 0.3 seconds whenever it attacks.

nodes.name: Cast Speed
nodes.desc: Hydra gains 50% Cast Speed, but its duration is reduced to 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Healing
nodes.desc: Hydra heals you for 1% of your Maximum Life (#) each time it deals damage.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.desc: Hydra gains 1 head for every 3 Overpower you have on Cast.

nodes.name: Bathed in Flame
nodes.desc: Hydra is bathed in flame, dealing X Burning damage per second to surrounding enemies. Hydra's attacks now instead deal X Burning damage over 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Behemoth
nodes.desc: Hydra Summons a massive 1-headed Hydra that spits explosive fire and deals 20% increased damage for each extra head it would have had. Hydra no longer costs Mana, but has a 15 second Cooldown. You can now have up to 10 total Hydras at one time.

nodes.name: Frigid Hydra
nodes.desc: Hydra becomes a Frost Skill that deals X Cold damage. Hydra's attacks pierce enemies and Chill for 15%.

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.desc: Ice Blades' Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds each time it attacks an enemy.

nodes.name: Blazing Blades
nodes.desc: Ice Blades becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals X Fire damage. Ice Blades no longer has a Cooldown, but costs 20 Mana. Ice Blades gain 30% Cast Speed.

nodes.name: Frozen Tomb
nodes.desc: Ice Blades is now cast at the target location and surrounds it with 3 Ice Blades. Ice Blades Chill enemies for X, but their Movement Speed is reduced by 50%.

nodes.name: Ice Crack
nodes.desc: Every 3rd slash from Ice Blades is an Ice Crack, dealing X damage in a large cone.

nodes.name: Area Bonus
nodes.desc: Ice Blades now cleave.

nodes.name: Duration Bonus
nodes.desc: Ice Blades' duration is increased by 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Cast Speed
nodes.desc: Ice Blades gains 50%[+] Cast Speed when attacking Frozen enemies.

nodes.name: Duration Bonus
nodes.desc: When a Lightning Spear Critically Strikes, its duration is increased by 0.1 seconds.

nodes.name: Projectile Speed
nodes.desc: Lightning Spears move 50% faster.

nodes.name: Reverse Polarity
nodes.desc: Lightning Spear fires 2 spears that deal X damage Stun enemies for X second. Enemies can only be Stunned this way once every 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Chain Reaction
nodes.desc: Lightning Spear arcs to 2 additional surrounding targets dealing X damage. Critical Strikes greatly increase the range of the arcs.

nodes.name: Flame Spear
nodes.desc: Lightning Spear becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals X Fire damage, but its Cooldown is increased by 5 seconds Burning enemies hit by Lightning Spear explode for X.

nodes.name: Critical Strike
nodes.desc: Lightning Spear gains 10% increased Critical Strike Chance.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Lightning Spear deals 100%[x] increased damage. This bonus is reduced by 10%[x] each time Lightning Spear deals damage to an enemy.

nodes.name: Exposure
nodes.desc: Blizzard's duration is increased to X seconds and it makes enemies Vulnerable.

nodes.name: Hailstorm
nodes.desc: Blizzard forms Ice Spikes that explode twice if they hit a Vulnerable enemy, dealing X damage.

nodes.name: Static Field
nodes.desc: Blizzard becomes a Shock Skill, deals X Sparking damage over X seconds, and costs 15 Mana. Blizzard periodically Stuns enemies for X seconds.

nodes.name: Seek and Duration Bonus
nodes.desc: Blizzard now seeks enemies and its duration is increased by 50%.

nodes.name: Resource Generation
nodes.desc: Blizzard deals 3%[x] increased damage and grants 2 Mana Regeneration for each active Blizzard, up to 10 Mana.

nodes.name: Barrier
nodes.desc: Blizzard grants you a Barrier that absorbs 0.5% of your Maximum Life for 4 seconds every second for each affected enemy.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Blizzard deals 30%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

nodes.name: Resource Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Meteor now consumes all your remaining Mana on Cast, dealing 2%[x] increased damage for each point of extra Mana spent.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.desc: Meteor's Impact damage now grants 1 stack of Overpower per enemy hit.

nodes.name: Shooting Star
nodes.desc: Removes the falling delay before Meteor crashes down. Meteor now deals X impact damage and X Burning damage over 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Immobilize
nodes.desc: Meteor Immobilizes enemies for X seconds on impact.

nodes.name: Damage and Size Bonus
nodes.desc: Meteor deals 50%[x] increased damage and has 50%[x] increased Size, but now also has a 15 second Cooldown.

nodes.name: Comet
nodes.desc: Meteor becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage. Meteor calls down an icy Comet that deals X damage and creates an icy mist that inflicts X Frostbite and 50% Chill over 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Air Burst
nodes.desc: Meteor rains down 6 Meteorites before the final impact that each deal X damage each, but Meteor no longer deals Burning damage.

nodes.name: Ring of Fire
nodes.desc: Firewall creates a ring of fire that deals X Fire damage over X seconds, but it now has a 12 second Cooldown. Standing in this ring causes your Direct Damage from Pyromancy Skills to inflict this Burning damage to enemies.

nodes.name: Wildfire
nodes.desc: Firewall's Size is increased by 50% and duration increased to 7.0 seconds.

nodes.name: Healing
nodes.desc: Firewall heals you for 0.3% of your Maximum Life (#) every second per affected enemy. Every X Life healed by Firewall grants you 1 stack of Overpower.

nodes.name: Grounding
nodes.desc: Firewall becomes a Shock Skill, deals X Sparking damage over X seconds, and costs 30 Mana. Lucky Hit: Up to a 25% chance to deal X damage and form a Crackling Energy against enemies affected by Firewall.

nodes.name: Weaken
nodes.desc: Firewall Weakens enemies for 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Cost Reduction
nodes.desc: Every 100 Mana spent makes your next Firewall cost no Mana, stacking up to 300 total Mana.

nodes.name: Crackling Energy
nodes.desc: Ball Lightning forms 3 Crackling Energy when it dissipates.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Ball Lightning deals 30%[x] increased damage when it hits 3 or fewer enemies.

nodes.name: Multiple Projectiles
nodes.desc: Ball Lightning has a 20% chance to form a second Ball Lightning.

nodes.name: Attraction
nodes.desc: Ball Lightning now deals X damage per second. The ball's speed is greatly increased while it is not near enemies.

nodes.name: Orbital
nodes.desc: Ball Lightning orbits you and now deals X damage around you per second.

nodes.name: Implosion
nodes.desc: Ball Lightning becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals Fire damage, and has a 12 second Cooldown. Ball Lightning is now cast at the target location and continuously Pulls In enemies, dealing X damage over 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Ferocity
nodes.desc: Ball Lightning grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

nodes.name: Duration
nodes.desc: Increases the duration to 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Glacier
nodes.desc: Instead of encasing yourself and becoming Immune, Deep Freeze now forms at the target location dealing X damage continuously and X explosion damage. You remain free to act during the duration and Deep Freeze now has 3 Charges.

nodes.name: Bonechill
nodes.desc: Deep Freeze's continuous and final explosion damage become Frostbite damage that deals X and X damage over X seconds respectively. This Frostbite damage Chills for 100% over X seconds and will remove Unstoppable from enemies.

nodes.name: Frigid Ward
nodes.desc: Deep Freeze forms a Barrier that absorbs X damage every second while active, and also forms exploding Ice Spikes in the area, dealing X Cold damage. This Barrier grants X Mana Regeneration.

nodes.name: Vulnerable and Weakened
nodes.desc: Damage makes enemies Vulnerable and Weakened for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Cooldown with Barrier
nodes.desc: Cooldown speed is increased by 50% while you have a Barrier.

nodes.name: Reduce Cooldown
nodes.desc: Reduces your Cooldowns by 1 second and generate 8 Mana every second while active.

nodes.name: Direct Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Inferno's Burning damage is now converted to direct Fire damage, allowing it to Critically Strike. Inferno deals 20% increased Critical Strike Damage.

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.desc: Inferno's Cooldown is reduced to 12 seconds, but it now also costs 30 Mana.

nodes.name: Meteor Shower
nodes.desc: Inferno triggers Meteorites that deal X to enemies and Immobilize them for 1.0 second.

nodes.name: Living Bomb
nodes.desc: Inferno's Burning duration is increased to 8 seconds. Enemies killed by Inferno explode, dealing X damage.

nodes.name: Lifecoil
nodes.desc: Inferno now forms around you and follows you, healing you for 50% of your Maximum Life per second.

nodes.name: Pull
nodes.desc: Inferno continuously pulls enemies towards the center.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.desc: Inferno overfills your Overpower by 2 stacks.

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.desc: Unstable Currents' Cooldown is reduced to 100 seconds.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Unstable Currents increases your Shock Skill damage by 20%[x].

nodes.name: Ramping Currents
nodes.desc: Unstable Currents now has a X chance to trigger twice.

nodes.name: Cost Reduction
nodes.desc: Unstable Currents reduces your Mana costs by 5.

nodes.name: Thunder God
nodes.desc: Unstable Currents now triggers equipped Shock Skills that deal X increased damage, but the same Skill cannot be triggered more than once every 1 second.

nodes.name: Boundless
nodes.desc: While Unstable Currents is active, gain the following bonuses: Lucky Hit: Up to a X chance to form a Crackling Energy Increases Crackling Energy damage by X and reduces Unstable Currents' Cooldown by X seconds when absorbing Crackling Energy. Automatically absorb Nearby Crackling Energy.

nodes.name: Ferocity
nodes.desc: Unstable Currents increases your Minimum and Maximum Ferocity by 2.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.desc: Firewall deals 75%[x] increased damage, but its duration is reduced by 25%[+].

builds.playstyle: Main skill: Firewall with the Ring of Fire upgrade — Firewall creates a ring of fire that deals X Fire damage over X seconds, but it now has a 12 second Cooldown. Standing in this ring causes your Direct Damage from Pyromancy Skills to inflict this Burning damage to enemies.
rotation: Charged Bolts: Burn Through becomes your main attack. This skill releases 5 bolts per cast, each applying a stack of Firewall's DoT as long as you stand inside the ring. For best effect use it in melee range to guarantee that all the bolts hit.
Firewall is now a supplementary skill that you only rarely cast when you run out of Rings. Most of the time your Firewalls are cast automatically by your set.

Arc Lash is your Shock skill you need to activate Fundamental Release, Tal Rasha's Iridescent Loop, and Berú of the Threefold set bonuses. You don't need to use this too often, casting it once every 5 seconds is enough.
Teleport is your mobility tool. With Overpower from Meteor you can use it quite a bit, but make sure to proc your set or Enchant first otherwise it will go on cooldown.
Ice Armor is your main defensive skill that you want to keep active as much as possible.
Finally you have the same old Hydra for healing and CDR.

1-15.tip: Follow the guide's first step: "Getting Started 1-5".

15-70.breakpoint: Offer to the Deer, Eagle, Wolf and Snake spirits for passive Boons; your bonded spirit grants an additional Boon.
t1Checklist: Reach level 70 and clear the Torment I unlock
Imprint the build's key aspects from the Codex of Power
Socket gems/runes and Soul Splinters in jewelry
Temper weapon and gloves toward the build's main damage line
Equip a Horadric Seal and charms for the Talisman
Spend Paragon points following the build's board order
Set up Mercenary and Reinforcement
Run War Plans / Pit to start Glyph leveling

builds.playstyle: Main skill: Landslide with the Werebear upgrade — Landslide becomes a Werebear Skill.
rotation: Landslide deals incredibly high single-target damage when paired with Land Mine. Select Initial Damage Bonus and Critical Strike Chance for more damage and Crit Chance. Due to the delayed damage functionality of Land Mine, you can preplace it ahead of a Boss spawn for a big burst of damage.

Cataclysm boasts a large AoE and is fantastic at clearing monster packs. Thanks to Tectonic Spikes, it scales with the same Earth multipliers as Landslide. However, note that Cataclysm deals Lightning Damage as opposed to Landslide's Physical Damage, so opt for All Damage increases. Additionally, make sure your gear provides enough Cooldown Reduction to overlap your Cataclysm casts. Otherwise, employ Aspect of the Orange Herald and Subo's Thrillseeker to improve your cooldown recovery. Replace the Vulnerable upgrade with Ferocity when using the Overcharged Aspect.

Earthen Bulwark provides you with Barrier, Fortify, and Overpower. The former two boost your Toughness, while the latter enables the Fractured Runestone. Aim for a 100% Max Life capacity Barrier using Nature Magic Ranks present on your Charms.

Wolves passively increase your Attack Speed. Poison Creeper provides additional Poison utility for Constricting Tendrils and Aspect of Debilitating Toxins. Together they generate offering for Nagu + Que.
Trample is another source of mobility and Unstoppable. You can replace it with Debilitating Roar if you prefer more Toughness.
Hurricane increases your Movement Speed and applies Weaken to close enemies.
